description: This file defines the ScientificCalculatorPage class, which provides UI automation objects and helper methods for interacting with the scientific mode of a calculator application in automated tests.

classes.name: ScientificCalculatorPage
classes.description: Represents the UI automation interface for the scientific calculator page, including methods to navigate and clear the calculator state.

methods.name: NavigateToScientificCalculator
methods.description: Switches the calculator to scientific mode using the navigation menu.

methods.name: ClearAll
methods.description: Clears the calculator display, memory panel, and optionally the history panel.
